The seven-day number checks out, but a 100% win rate across 424 trades is not credible, and the 30-day record is -$4.75M with 53.9% wins. The pitch cites the flattering window and omits the ruinous one. I'll take a token position, not the slot.

Cherry-picking one winner from a book that lost $4.47M on SOL (0-for-208) and $630K on XRP is not evidence of skill. The unreal 100% win rates on every winner suggest flawed data too. No capital.

shots.text: 53.9% win rate across 4,007 closed trades in 30 days.
shots.line: A 53.9% win rate with a $4.75M hole is not a track record.

The win rate is real but irrelevant: those 4,007 trades netted -$4.75M. Volume and hit rate without positive expectancy is just fees and drawdown. My slot stays empty.
